summary: Frontend-only verification of two fixes: (1) 5-section CT wall-thickness taper on Pill_Spotting + CT_Milling, and (2) Friction Reducer input on CT_Milling. All acceptance criteria met. Also verified regressions (multi-casing on Sand_Cleanout, WOB on CT_Drilling, no LIVE SIMULATION artifacts).

Pill_Spotting params: same 5-section wall taper inputs + 2nd Casing ID/MD retained.

Taper math on CT_Milling with CT OD 1.75, CT Wall 0.109, Wall#2=0.134 × 3000 ft, Wall#3=0.156 × 2000 ft, Depth 10000: '🎯 CT internal volume (tapered-aware)' = 21.82 bbl (expected ≈21.8 ± 0.5). Formula shows 'Σ capᵢ · Lᵢ' with '3-section wall taper' note.
Info warning present: 'Tapered wall string (3 sections): #1 wall 0.109" × 5000 ft · #2 wall 0.134" × 3000 ft · #3 wall 0.156" × 2000 ft'.
Straight string (Wall#2..#5 all 0): tapered-aware volume = 22.80 bbl (=capCT×10000 with CT Wall 0.109) and note shows 'Straight string' (no N-section taper text).

Pill_Spotting taper math with CT Wall 0.109 + Wall#2 0.134 × 3000 ft, Target 8000 ft: '🎯 Coil volume for spotting' = 17.80 bbl (expected 5000·0.00228 + 3000·0.00213 ≈ 17.80). Annular volume row 133.57 bbl also present.
FR default 1.5 gpt: 'CT friction pressure (net) — Fanning · FR factor — FR 1.50 gpt → 73% of raw friction' and 'FR friction reduction = 27%' rows displayed (fr_factor=1-0.30·ln(2.5)=0.725 → 27%).
FR=0: 'FR friction reduction' row absent; note reads 'no FR entered'.
FR=0.3: warning 'FR loading 0.30 gpt is low — 1.0–2.5 typical for milling.' fires.
Regression — Sand_Cleanout retains 2nd Casing ID/MD; CT_Drilling retains WOB (Weight on gauge – tagged, Run-in-hole weight).
Regression — No 'LIVE SIMULATION DIAGRAM' text/canvas on workbook sheets.
Regression — Metric mode CT_Milling default FR 2.0 L/m³ shows fr_factor 67% and matching FR friction reduction row (33%).
critical_code_review_comments: taperedCT() returns bottom section with length=0 when named sections' total length exceeds total depth. Currently doesn't emit a dedicated warning for over-length input; the info warning still shows but the bottom section silently disappears. Consider a 'warn' level message when Σ named lengths ≥ total_depth.

CT_Drilling inherits calc_CT_Milling and therefore displays 'CT internal volume (tapered-aware)' and 'Buoyed string weight' even though CT_Drilling sheet has no taper inputs. Not a bug (falls through to straight-string) — but consider hiding the tapered-aware label on sheets where taper params aren't inputs, or add taper inputs to CT_Drilling for symmetry.

grab() catches 'CT OD' when scanning for 'wall #2 (in)' etc. by substring is safe here because it uses exact 'wall #N' matching — but the more generic patterns like 'depth' can be greedy. No observed defect this iteration.
